info.title: NSE India Market Data API
info.description: Live market data from the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE), with no key. Read the live value of every NSE index (NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY, NIFTY NEXT 50 and the rest) with open/high/low, day change and 52-week range; check the open/close status of each market segment; pull the day's top gainers and losers for any index group; and read the most-active securities by traded value or volume. The Indian-equities / stock-index / market-movers layer for trading dashboards, screeners, fintech and research — distinct from US-stock and FX-rate readers. Live from NSE; short cache only.

get.summary: A single NSE index by name

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Index name, e.g. NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY

data.note: One NSE index by name — last value, open/high/low, previous close, day change and 52-week range. Pass name (e.g. NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY).

get.summary: Live value of every NSE index

data.note: The live value of every NSE index — NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY, NIFTY NEXT 50 and the rest — each with last, open, high, low, previous close, day change and 52-week high/low. The headline pulse of the Indian equity market.

indices.index: NIFTY INDIA CORPORATE GROUP INDEX - TATA GROUP 25% CAP
NIFTY 15 YR AND ABOVE G-SEC INDEX

data.note: The open/close status of each NSE market segment (Capital Market, Currency, Commodity, Debt) with its reference index level. Check whether the Indian market is trading right now.

The most-active securities on NSE by traded value or volume — each with its last price, day change, quantity traded and total traded value. Pass by=value or by=volume. The day's busiest Indian stocks.

The day's top gainers or losers on NSE for an index group — each with its last price, open/high/low, net and percent change, traded quantity and turnover. Pass direction (gainers|losers) and group (NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, NIFTYNEXT50, FOSec, allSec…).

data.source: NSE India public site API (nseindia.com/api), keyless

endpoints.GET /v1/indices: Live value of every NSE index.
endpoints.GET /v1/market-status: Open/close status of each market segment.
